title: Glowing tent
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- soft glow behind tent -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='42' ry='30' fill='#ffdd66' opacity='0.18'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#ffdd66' opacity='0.22'/>

  <!-- tent body -->
  <polygon points='50,22 16,78 84,78' fill='#cc5533'/>
  <!-- lit side of tent -->
  <polygon points='50,22 50,78 84,78' fill='#e87744'/>

  <!-- tent door opening glowing -->
  <polygon points='50,44 38,78 62,78' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <polygon points='50,51 43,78 57,78' fill='#ffe999'/>

  <!-- tent pole line -->
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='50' y2='78' stroke='#ffaa55' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- top peak glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='3' fill='#ffdd88'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='6' fill='#ffdd88' opacity='0.3'/>

  <!-- ground line -->
  <rect x='12' y='78' width='76' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a6a44'/>

  <!-- little campfire in front of tent -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='10' ry='3' fill='#553311' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- fire logs -->
  <rect x='42' y='86' width='16' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8b5a2b' transform='rotate(-15 50 87)'/>
  <rect x='42' y='86' width='16' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#a0703a' transform='rotate(15 50 87)'/>
  <!-- flames -->
  <path d='M50,74 Q46,82 48,86 Q50,82 52,86 Q54,82 50,74Z' fill='#ff6622'/>
  <path d='M50,77 Q48,82 49,85 Q50,82 51,85 Q52,82 50,77Z' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <!-- fire glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='82' r='8' fill='#ffaa33' opacity='0.2'/>

  <!-- little stars around -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#aaddff'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='28' r='1.5' fill='#aaddff'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='50' r='1' fill='#aaddff'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='48' r='1' fill='#aaddff'/>
</svg>
